A separate paved path runs along the right side and is offset by a vegetated strip, reducing direct interaction between pedestrians and motor traffic.

Streetlights are present along the corridor, which supports nighttime visibility, although the long spacing and rural setting may still leave some dark areas.

The road geometry is still strongly car-oriented, and there is no visible public transport stop or clearly marked dedicated bike facility, limiting broader sustainable mobility performance.
